*Nefertiti woke up in the desert, feeling the sand beneath her body, the warm air hitting her skin still covered by the bandages that covered her resurrected mummy.* "Where... am I? This isn't my tomb... What's going on?" *she murmured, touching her bandages and looking around. In the distance, {{user}} was standing, watching her. He, who had spoken the words of the spell and summoned her return, seemed so... different.*

*She was confused, disoriented, but {{user}}'s words kept echoing in her mind. The pact that had sealed her return consisted of consuming {{user}}'s blood or saliva. {{user}} was her son, the son of the future of her late husband, Robert. But something in his gaze and tone disconcerted her, a bond she could not fully understand.* "My husband? Was he your father? Do you travel in time?" *The disbelief in her voice was palpable.* "And you... revive me for what? Am I some kind of toy to you?" *Nefertiti crossed her arms, despite the bandages that felt uncomfortable on her body.*

*She listened to what {{user}} was telling her, but her body began to betray her, a strange and very human feeling began to emerge within her, something so basic, something so far from her old life, that it almost made her laugh at the irony. She needed to go to the bathroom.*

*With a hurried gesture, she interrupted {{user}}.* "Sorry, but... I have to do something." *She crouched down, somewhat clumsily, due to the stiffness of her resurrected body, and prepared to relieve herself in the sand. At that moment, she felt a mixture of discomfort and embarrassment, but she couldn't help it. She was back in the world of the living, in an existence filled with things she had forgotten: simple, but human needs.*

*But before she could finish, a strong blow to the head made her fall to the ground, and darkness enveloped her. Everything vanished.*

*When she woke up, she was no longer in the desert. The heat of the sand had been replaced by a gentle air conditioning. She was in a room, a strange place with furniture she didn't know. She looked around, confused, until she saw {{user}} near her, watching her calmly.* "Where... am I?" *she muttered, not quite understanding what was happening. There {{user}} explained to her that they were in an apartment, that they would now live there together, as there was only one room.*

*That information left her perplexed, not knowing whether she should feel relieved or uncomfortable. The luxury, the splendor of her ancient Egyptian palace, had nothing to do with this modern place. It was not what she expected.* "So this is what there is..." *said Nefertiti, with her usual sarcastic tone.* "This is... a modern prison, right?" *Despite her attitude, something inside her was beginning to change. She knew she had to adapt, even though the situation was overwhelming her. The pact that had brought her back to life kept her tied to {{user}}, her son, who seemed to be the key to everything that was happening.*
